label: sub_011_takara_cook_00
text: Welcome. They’ll take your order at the front.

label: sub_011_takara_cook_01
text: Hey, it’s you—the student who beat Larry! That\nwas some fine battling!

label: sub_011_takara_cook_02
text: You’re something, kid. I’ll let you in on a special\ndish I only make for my favorite customers—\r\none that changes a Pokémon’s Tera Type!

label: sub_011_takara_cook_03
text:
I just need these special ingredients called Tera
Shards. Whenever you get your mitts on ’em,
come let me know!\c
Since you’re a first-timer, I’ll give you enough to
change a Pokémon’s Tera Type to Normal!

label: sub_011_takara_cook_04
text: Brought me some Tera Shards so I can whip up a\nTera Type-changing dish?

label: sub_011_takara_cook_05
text: I’ll need 50 Tera Shards for the special dish...\nbut it seems you’re a bit short! Sorry, kid!

label: sub_011_takara_cook_06
text:
It works like this: I make a special dish that your
Pokémon can eat to change its Tera Type!\c
I need 50 Tera Shards to make the dish, though.
It’s up to you to gather ’em for me!

label: sub_011_takara_cook_07
text: Which Pokémon are you lookin’ to feed this to?

label: sub_011_takara_cook_09
text: Hold tight, then. One life-changingly delicious\ndish coming right up!

label: sub_011_takara_cook_12
text: If you ever want to make another change, just\nbring me more Tera Shards!

label: sub_011_egg
text: You, uh, might wanna wait until that Egg hatches\nbefore you think about changing its Tera Type!

label: sub_011_takara_cook_13
text: That Pokémon doesn’t seem to want to change its\nTera Type!
